```{r Set_up, include = FALSE}
# Ẩn toàn bộ code + output của chính chunk này
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,  
  comment = "##",
  dpi = 600, 
  fig.width = 8.5, 
  fig.height = 4.5, 
  cache = FALSE)

# Nạp gói và theme, chặn mọi message khởi động
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
  pacman::p_load(
    tidyverse, gtsummary, gt, flextable, officer, broom,
    performance, car, forcats, glue, janitor, here)
  theme_gtsummary_journal(journal = "jama")})
```

```{r Prepare_data, include = FALSE}
# Chuẩn bị dữ liệu (nền)
# Import file làm sạch số liệu vào trong file phân tích số liệu
knitr::knit_child("prepare_raw_data.Rmd", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r Table_1_A, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Table 1: Bảng mô tả biến số phần A
data1_processed <- data1_processed |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    A10_hospital_treated = forcats::fct_infreq(as.factor(A10_hospital_treated)),
    dplyr::across(
      c(age_category, A2_gender, A4_education_level, A5_marital_status,
        A6_living_situation, A7_occupation_broad, A8_monthly_income,
        A9_payment_method, A11_1_clinical_department_cleaned,
        A12_0_admission_reason_fix, length_of_stay_group,
        A14_other_chronic_disease, A15_health_insurance,
        A16_used_insurance_for_payment, A17_discharge_condition,
        A18_physical_health_perception, A19_mental_health_perception),
      ~ as.factor(.x)
    )
  )

table_1 <- data1_processed |>
  dplyr::select(
    age_category, A2_gender, A4_education_level, A5_marital_status,
    A6_living_situation, A7_occupation_broad, A8_monthly_income,
    A9_payment_method, A10_hospital_treated, A12_0_admission_reason_fix,
    length_of_stay_clean,
    A14_other_chronic_disease, A15_health_insurance,
    A16_used_insurance_for_payment, A17_discharge_condition,
    A18_physical_health_perception, A19_mental_health_perception
  ) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      age_category ~ "Age Group (years)",
      A2_gender ~ "Gender",
      A4_education_level ~ "Education Level",
      A5_marital_status ~ "Marital Status",
      A6_living_situation ~ "Living Situation",
      A7_occupation_broad ~ "Occupation",
      A8_monthly_income ~ "Monthly Income",
      A9_payment_method ~ "Payment Method",
      A10_hospital_treated ~ "Hospital Treated",
      A12_0_admission_reason_fix ~ "Admission Reason",
      length_of_stay_clean ~ "Length of Stay (days)",
      A14_other_chronic_disease ~ "Other Chronic Disease",
      A15_health_insurance ~ "Health Insurance",
      A16_used_insurance_for_payment ~ "Used Insurance for Payment",
      A17_discharge_condition ~ "Discharge Condition",
      A18_physical_health_perception ~ "Physical Health Perception",
      A19_mental_health_perception ~ "Mental Health Perception"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    type = list(
      length_of_stay_clean ~ "continuous"
    ),
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) |>
  gtsummary::bold_labels() |>
  gtsummary::modify_header(
    label  ~ "**Characteristic**",
    stat_0 ~ "**Overall**\nN = {N}"
  )
```

```{r table_2}
# Chuẩn hoá NA thành "Không áp dụng" cho một số biến B*
data1_processed$B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control <-
  forcats::fct_explicit_na(data1_processed$B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control, na_level = "Không áp dụng")
data1_processed$B14_medication_side_effects_explained <-
  forcats::fct_explicit_na(data1_processed$B14_medication_side_effects_explained, na_level = "Không áp dụng")

# Dữ liệu hoàn chỉnh cho model 1
model1_data <- data1_processed %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(c1_overall_experience_binary),
    !is.na(B1_doctor_clear_answers),
    !is.na(B2_nurse_clear_answers),
    !is.na(B4_doctor_clear_communication),
    !is.na(B8_respectful_treatment_by_staff)
  )

# Logistic regression (Core Communication)
model1 <- glm(
  c1_overall_experience_binary ~
    B1_doctor_clear_answers +
    B2_nurse_clear_answers +
    B3_consistent_staff_answers +
    B4_doctor_clear_communication +
    B5_doctor_anxiety_counseling +
    B6_nurse_anxiety_counseling +
    B7_want_treatment_decision_participation +
    B8_respectful_treatment_by_staff +
    B9_shared_concerns_with_staff +
    B10_experienced_pain +
    B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control +
    B11_family_communication_with_doctor +
    B12_family_received_recovery_information +
    B13_clear_medication_instructions +
    B14_medication_side_effects_explained +
    B15_warning_signs_explained,
  family = binomial, data = model1_data
)

# Bảng OR (flextable)
tbl_model1_flex <-
  tbl_regression(
    model1,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(
      B1_doctor_clear_answers ~ "B1 - Doctor clear answers",
      B2_nurse_clear_answers ~ "B2 - Nurse clear answers",
      B3_consistent_staff_answers ~ "B3 - Consistent staff answers",
      B4_doctor_clear_communication ~ "B4 - Doctor clear communication",
      B5_doctor_anxiety_counseling ~ "B5 - Doctor anxiety counseling",
      B6_nurse_anxiety_counseling ~ "B6 - Nurse anxiety counseling",
      B7_want_treatment_decision_participation ~ "B7 - Treatment decision participation",
      B8_respectful_treatment_by_staff ~ "B8 - Respectful treatment by staff",
      B9_shared_concerns_with_staff ~ "B9 - Shared concerns with staff",
      B10_experienced_pain ~ "B10 - Experienced pain",
      B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control ~ "B10_1 - Staff helped pain control",
      B11_family_communication_with_doctor ~ "B11 - Family communication with doctor",
      B12_family_received_recovery_information ~ "B12 - Family received recovery information",
      B13_clear_medication_instructions ~ "B13 - Clear medication instructions",
      B14_medication_side_effects_explained ~ "B14 - Medication side effects explained",
      B15_warning_signs_explained ~ "B15 - Warning signs explained"
    ),
    estimate_fun = ~style_ratio(.x, digits = 3),
    pvalue_fun   = ~style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)
  ) %>%
  bold_p(t = 0.05) %>%
  modify_header(
    label = "**Variable**",
    estimate = "**Adjusted OR**",
    ci = "**95% CI**",
    p.value = "**p-value**"
  ) %>%
  as_flex_table() %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#D9D9D9") %>%
  color(part = "header", color = "black") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  align(j = c("estimate","ci","p.value"), align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  align(j = "label", align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  add_footer_lines(paste0("OR = Odds Ratio; CI = Confidence Interval; N = ", stats::nobs(model1))) %>%
  fontsize(part = "footer", size = 9) %>%
  italic(part = "footer") %>%
  autofit()
```

tbl_model1_flex

```{r}
# Chuẩn hoá lại một số biến danh mục nếu chưa có
data1_processed <- data1_processed %>%
  mutate(
    A12_0_admission_reason_fix = case_when(
      A12_0_admission_reason_code %in% c("Dịch vụ sản khoa", "Điều trị hoá chất", "Khác") ~ "Khác",
      A12_0_admission_reason_code == "Điều trị bệnh mạn tính" ~ "Điều trị bệnh mạn tính",
      A12_0_admission_reason_code == "Điều trị đợt cấp của bệnh" ~ "Điều trị đợt cấp của bệnh",
      A12_0_admission_reason_code == "Nhập viện cấp cứu" ~ "Nhập viện cấp cứu",
      A12_0_admission_reason_code == "Phẫu thuật/thủ thuật" ~ "Phẫu thuật/thủ thuật",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    A9_payment_method_group = case_when(
      A9_payment_method %in% c("Được BHXH chi trả", "Tự chi trả được") ~ "Không gặp vấn đề với việc chi trả viện phí",
      A9_payment_method %in% c("Phải vay mượn", "Vừa được BHXH chi trả và vừa vay mượn") ~ "Gặp khó khăn với việc chi trả viện phí",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Đảm bảo các biến B có mức "Không áp dụng" thay vì NA
data1_processed$B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control <-
  forcats::fct_explicit_na(data1_processed$B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control, na_level = "Không áp dụng")
data1_processed$B14_medication_side_effects_explained <-
  forcats::fct_explicit_na(data1_processed$B14_medication_side_effects_explained, na_level = "Không áp dụng")

# ====== ƯỚC LƯỢNG CÁC MÔ HÌNH (chạy nền) ======
model_6 <- lm(C1_overall_hospital_experience_score ~
               A2_gender + age_category + A4_education_level + A5_marital_status +
               A6_living_situation + A7_0_occupation_code + A8_monthly_income +
               A9_payment_method + A10_hospital_treated +
               A11_1_clinical_department_code + A12_0_admission_reason_code +
               length_of_stay_clean + A14_other_chronic_disease + A15_health_insurance +
               A16_used_insurance_for_payment + A17_discharge_condition +
               A18_physical_health_perception + A19_mental_health_perception +
               C2_trust_hospital_quality + C3_would_recommend_hospital +
               C4_hospital_loyalty + C5_intention_to_return,
             data = data1_processed)

model_7 <- lm(C1_overall_hospital_experience_score ~
               A2_gender + A4_education_level + A7_occupation_broad +
               A9_payment_method_group + A12_0_admission_reason_fix +
               length_of_stay_clean + A16_used_insurance_for_payment,
             data = data1_processed)

model_A <- lm(C1_overall_hospital_experience_score ~
                A2_gender + A4_education_level + A7_occupation_broad +
                A9_payment_method_group + A12_0_admission_reason_fix +
                length_of_stay_clean,
              data = data1_processed)

model_A_sensitivity <- lm(C1_overall_hospital_experience_score ~
                            A2_gender + A4_education_level + A7_occupation_broad +
                            A9_payment_method_group + A12_0_admission_reason_fix +
                            length_of_stay_clean,
                          data = data1_processed[-c(1463, 3201, 3229, 3248), ])

model_B <- lm(C1_overall_hospital_experience_score ~
                B1_doctor_clear_answers + B2_nurse_clear_answers + B3_consistent_staff_answers +
                B4_doctor_clear_communication + B5_doctor_anxiety_counseling +
                B6_nurse_anxiety_counseling + B7_want_treatment_decision_participation +
                B8_respectful_treatment_by_staff + B9_shared_concerns_with_staff +
                B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control + B11_family_communication_with_doctor +
                B12_family_received_recovery_information + B13_clear_medication_instructions +
                B14_medication_side_effects_explained + B15_warning_signs_explained,
              data = data1_processed)

model_B_sensitivity <- lm(C1_overall_hospital_experience_score ~
                            B1_doctor_clear_answers + B2_nurse_clear_answers + B3_consistent_staff_answers +
                            B4_doctor_clear_communication + B5_doctor_anxiety_counseling +
                            B6_nurse_anxiety_counseling + B7_want_treatment_decision_participation +
                            B8_respectful_treatment_by_staff + B9_shared_concerns_with_staff +
                            B10_1_staff_helped_pain_control + B11_family_communication_with_doctor +
                            B12_family_received_recovery_information + B13_clear_medication_instructions +
                            B14_medication_side_effects_explained + B15_warning_signs_explained,
                          data = data1_processed[-c(1463, 3201, 3229, 3248), ])

# ====== GHÉP BẢNG: áp bold_p() TRƯỚC khi merge ======
tbl_list_named <- list(
  "Model 6" = model_6,
  "Model 7" = model_7,
  "Model A" = model_A,
  "Model A (sensitivity)" = model_A_sensitivity,
  "Model B" = model_B,
  "Model B (sensitivity)" = model_B_sensitivity
)

tbls_to_merge <-
  purrr::imap(
    tbl_list_named,
    ~ tbl_regression(
        .x,
        intercept    = FALSE,
        estimate_fun = ~style_number(.x, digits = 3),
        pvalue_fun   = ~style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)
      ) %>%
      bold_p(t = 0.05) %>%
      modify_caption(glue("{.y}"))
  )

tbl_models_merged <-
  tbl_merge(
    tbls = unname(tbls_to_merge),
    tab_spanner = names(tbl_list_named)
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Term**")

# >>> TÍNH SẴN CỘT CẦN CĂN GIỮA (LOẠI "label") TRƯỚC KHI as_flex_table()
body_cols <- setdiff(names(tbl_models_merged$table_body), "label")

tbl_models_merged_flex <-
  tbl_models_merged |>
  as_flex_table() |>
  theme_vanilla() |>
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#D9D9D9") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(part = "header", align = "center") |>
  align(part = "body", align = "center") |>
  align(part = "body", j = "label", align = "left") |>
  add_header_lines("Comparative coefficients across linear models") |>
  fontsize(part = "footer", size = 9) |>
  autofit()
```
